第52章 活捉香獐子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

灌木从旁边。

一只野物正躺在地上，口中还吐着泡泡，不知道被麻翻了多久，大壮等人见到后，眼前顿时一亮。

“獐子，山哥，咱们的运气不错啊，竟然是一只獐子！”

大山脸上流露出一抹兴奋之色道。

“这是香獐子！”

“身体是棕红色的，还有身下那玩意，山哥我说的对不对？”

赵红旗开口道。

“不错，这东西是香獐子，可比獐子价值高多了。”

“本以为撞一撞运气，没想到还真的撞上了。”

李青山望着躺在地上的香獐子，开口道：“大壮，把你的背篓清一清，底下铺一些草！”

自己的三个同伴中。

大壮的背篓最大，最宽，很适合暂时将香獐子放在里面。

“我想起来了，这不就是咱们昨天看到的那只香獐子吗？没想到运气这么好，说抓就抓到了？”

大壮也突然想了起来，一边将背篓放下来铺上草，一边惊喜道。

“昨天咱们看到的那只香獐子，比这只稍微大上一些！”

“这只要稍微小上一些。”

“这附近肯定不止这一只香獐子，肯定还有，最起码还会有一只咱们昨天看到的，有雄性的香獐子，肯定就会有雌性的香獐子，咱们要是运气好的话，说不定能在这附近配上两三对香獐子。”

“香獐子的饲养场，就有着落了。”

李青山脸上也满是兴奋，小心翼翼将香獐子从地上抱起来，放在大壮的背篓中，四肢蹄子被李青山捆住了，眼睛也被蒙住，背篓里面还有一些鲜嫩的草，都是香獐子熟悉的味道，应该不会应激！

香獐子比狍子要小上很多。

这一只才二十斤出头，身长不到一米，蜷缩着在背篓里面刚刚好。

“大壮，二壮，红旗！”

“原本我打算咱们大后天的时候回去的，但是现在活捉了一只香獐子，我打算今天晚上咱们就直接连夜赶回去，尽快将香獐子处置好了，这可是关乎咱们日后的生活。”

李青山怀揣着激动的心情道。

“行，山哥，我们都听你的。”赵红旗和大壮兄弟二人，郑重点头道。

“走，先回去！”

李青山将东西收拾好，便朝着趟子房内赶。

这一趟出来，也已经打到了不少猎物，加起来凑合凑合，一百块钱肯定有的，光是那三只水獭就够一百出头了，还有一只獐子呢。

Bushes from the side.

A wild animal was lying on the ground with bubbles spitting out of its mouth. It was unknown how long it had been lying there. When Da Zhuang and others saw it, their eyes suddenly lit up.

"Deer deer, Brother Shan, we are lucky, it turned out to be a deer!"

Dashan's face showed a hint of excitement.

"This is the fragrant deer!"

"The body is brown and red, and there's that thing underneath. Brother Shan, am I right?"

Zhao Hongqi said.

"Yes, this thing is fragrant deer, but it is much more valuable than deer."

"I thought it was a chance of luck, but I didn't expect it to happen."

Li Qingshan looked at the fragrant deer lying on the ground and said, "Dazhuang, clear your backpack and put some grass under it!"

Among his three companions.

The strong backpack is the largest and widest, which is very suitable for temporarily placing the fragrant deer in it.

"I remembered. Isn't this the fragrant deer we saw yesterday? I didn't expect to be so lucky. I caught it right away."

Da Zhuang also suddenly thought of it, and said in surprise as he put down the backpack and spread it on the grass.

"The fragrant deer we saw yesterday was slightly bigger than this one!"

"It just needs to be a little smaller."

"There must be more than just this fragrant deer around here. There must be another one. At least there will be the male fragrant deer we saw yesterday. There will definitely be a female fragrant deer. If we are lucky, maybe we can get two or three pairs of fragrant deer nearby."

"The breeding farm for fragrant deer has been established."

Li Qingshan's face was also full of excitement. He carefully picked up the fragrant deer from the ground and put it in a strong basket. His limbs and hooves were tied up by Li Qingshan, and his eyes were blindfolded. There was some fresh grass in the basket, which was the familiar smell of the fragrant deer. It should not cause stress!

The fragrant deer is much smaller than the roe deer.

This one weighs just over twenty pounds and is less than one meter long. It fits snugly in the backpack.

"Big strong, second strong, red flag!"

"Originally, I planned to go back the day after tomorrow, but now that we have captured a fragrant deer alive, I plan to rush back tonight and deal with the fragrant deer as soon as possible. This is related to our future lives."

Li Qingshan said with excitement.

"Okay, Brother Shan, we all listen to you." Brother Zhao Hongqi and Da Zhuang nodded solemnly.

"Let's go back first!"

Li Qingshan packed up his things and hurried towards Tianzi's room.

On this trip, we have already caught a lot of prey. If we add it up, we can make do with it. One hundred yuan is definitely enough. The three otters alone are enough to cost over one hundred yuan, and there is also a deer.
